title: Jaamu xam-xam bu nëbbu bi
intro: Ci biir taarixu Al Quran, amna nit ku yéeme, di jaamu Yàlla bu am xam-xam ak yërmaande gu Yàlla jox. Nit ku am kumpa gi dafa jàkkarloo ak kenn ci yonent yi gëna mag, mu yóbbu ko ci tukki bu fees dell ak jëf yu jaaxal nit ñi, yuy jafeel xam-xamu doomi aadama yi. Jëf bu nekk, ak limu nuru lu jaarul yoon, mingi nëbb njàngalem ëlëg, muñ, ak xam-xam buñu dul gis bi nekk ci ginaaw dogal bi Yàlla tëral. Kan mooy nit ku lëndëm kii, te ban dëgg lañu wane?
clues: Jaamu Yàlla laa woon, tànnee ko ngir xam-xam bu amul fenn ak yërmaande.
Yonent bu mag dafa bëggoon jàng ci man, ma nangu ci ay sart yu tar.
Bi ñuy ndaje, def naa ñatti mbir yu sama àndadoo jàpp ni du yoon.
Ma yàq gaal gu néew doole yi, waaye yërmaande gu nëbbu la woon.
Dama ray benn xale bu góor, doonte daa melni lu metti, dama ko defoon ngir baña naqarlu ay waajuram.
Ma tabaxaat benn miir ci benn dëkk bu nu bañoon dalal, ma wane alal ci suufa miir bi.

identity.label: Man Kan laa?
options: Buur bi doon werante ak Ibraayma

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Daje ak Yonent bi Musa ci wetu ñaari géej yi
Tabax benn bariyer ci Gog ak Magog
Ñu sànni leen ci safara bu tàng
trial.answer: Daje ak Yonent bi Musa ci wetu ñaari géej yi

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Mu leeral xam-xam bu Yàlla def ci jëfam yu jaaxal nit ñi, ba noppi mu tàqaloo ak Musa
Ginnaaw tukki bi la may ko muy yonent .
Gaal gi dafa yàqu ndax taw bu metti
Tabax na jumaa ci dëkk bu amul nit ñi
outcome.answer: Mu leeral xam-xam bu Yàlla def ci jëfam yu jaaxal nit ñi, ba noppi mu tàqaloo ak Musa

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
